title: Pickle of a Pickleball Day
style: Country-pop with a sunlit 92 BPM bounce, steady kick-snare clap, bright acoustic strum, hand percussion, and a warm bass pulse; verse rides tight and conversational, pre-chorus lifts with filtered harmony stacks, chorus opens into gang vocals on the hook. Michelle’s lead vocal stays close-mic and upbeat with doubled lines, short delay throws on the title, and handclaps on the backbeat. Ear candy includes seed packet foley, a soft whistle pickup, and a riser into the final chorus. Mix is bright, organic, and radio-clean, rich, low, clean, clever, light, scratch, strong, natural
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sunrise on the wicking beds,
cucumbers hanging low.
Michelle grabs her paddle,
time to make the good stuff grow.
She calls the dinks and drives
with a smile that lights the day,
Teaching kids and neighbors
how to move and how to play.

[Pre-Chorus]
From the garden rows
to the painted baseline so clean…
Everything we grow
and everything we dream…

[Chorus]
It’s a pickle of a pickleball day!
Twenty dollars in cucumbers sold the natural way!
Grown from seed in compost that we brewed in our own home,
Rammed earth bricks and wicking beds — watch our garden roam!
Michelle on the court
with her whistle and her heart so true,
A pickle of a pickleball day —
made for you!

[Verse 2]
Started with a vision,
just dirt and a dream in our hands,
Turned kitchen scraps to black gold
in the compost stands.
Mixed the soils by feel
till they were rich, alive, and right,
Built the beds with rammed earth bricks
standing strong in the light.

[Bridge]
Water wicks up natural
from the hidden reservoir below,
Cucumbers went wild —
put on one hell of a show.
Hand in hand we build it —
garden, court, and family,
Michelle leading both with love
and clarity.

[Final Chorus]
It’s a pickle of a pickleball day!
(pickleball day!)
Twenty dollars in cucumbers — we just sold ’em the natural way!
(twenty dollars!)
From seed to the serve, from the soil to the biggest smile,
Michelle you’re the coach making everything worthwhile!
Rammed earth strong, wicking beds clever and fine,
This pickle of a day is yours and mine!
It’s a pickle of a pickleball day…
